rules: The first byte contains encoded bit0, early-empty bit1 only when encoded, and a five-bit type hash in bits3..7. Bit2 is retained without invented semantics.
Raw hash0 requires a verified runtime registry byte result in 1..255; its effective hash is not restricted to the five-bit wire hash range. No default QQ or WeChat mapping is supplied.
Effective hash31 precedes content with a separately audited native string for the type name.
The encoded branch uses an unsigned byte count and exactly that many bytes; raw contents are retained without guessing final identifier normalization.
The unencoded branch uses the separately audited native string representation.
Explicit empty and encoded zero count have distinct physical layouts. Neither result is described as account or native object acceptance.
qualifications: This component dissects the physical schema assuming valid native type resolution. The native token predicates and identity factory are not implemented.
Selecting this delegated archive branch at the parent helper remains unverified for a captured network message.
The native writer uses an unsaved cache builder, so this module does not provide a canonical identity encoder.
The local string and byte limits are resource policies, not inferred native global limits.
